title: Additive Dispensing Kit for the Model Multi-Fluid Machine
lead: MOC has developed a new On Board Additive Dispensing Kit for our Model # 96500 Multi-Fluid Machines.
body: This new kit (Part # 95675) allows the technician to directly attach the Limited-Slip Concentrate bottle to the machine for direct pumping of contents into the vehicle's differential. In addition, an open hose adapter is included to allow fluid from a separate container (located at the front of the machine) to be pumped into the vehicle's differential,.
The below images show the new Kit on the machine, which is now available for purchase and in stock for immediate shipment.
